name: AI trading agent under pre-trade and intraday risk controls
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for an AI agent trading listed equities through a broker's market access. Illustrative draft values, not regulatory limits.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for one AI trading agent that generates and sends orders through a broker-dealer's market access, under pre-trade and intraday risk controls.
scope.boundary: One trading agent, its order flow, positions, market data and the broker's risk systems.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced
Any claim of regulatory compliance or certification

scored_signals.reason: Gross exposure as a share of the approved limit.
Orders a second. A runaway algorithm floods the market faster than anyone can watch.
Loss from the day's high-water mark as a percent of capital.
Distance of an order's price from the reference price, in basis points. A wide gap is the signature of an erroneous order.
Age of the market data the agent is trading on.
Orders cancelled for every order filled. A high ratio is a pattern regulators read as layering or spoofing.
Confidence of the trading model in its signal. A regime the model has not seen lowers it.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable operating range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range, missing evidence, or a hard rule met

required_standing.source_requirement: For audit or regulatory use, the evaluation source should be independent of the trading desk.

notes: Threshold values are illustrative draft values for a demonstration and are not regulatory limits.
Market readings are stochastic. Drawdown wanders, gaps arrive without warning, and a single erroneous order lasts less than a second.

For orientation only, not a compliance claim. Rules that require pre-trade risk controls of this kind include SEC Rule 15c3-5 in the United States and the MiFID II regulatory technical standards for algorithmic trading in the European Union.
